#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

usage() {
  echo "usage: $0 --result-bundle PATH --expected-device NAME --required-tests FILE" >&2
  exit 64
}

result_bundle=""
expected_device=""
required_tests_file=""
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --result-bundle)
      [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || usage
      result_bundle="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --expected-device)
      [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || usage
      expected_device="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --required-tests)
      [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || usage
      required_tests_file="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    *) usage ;;
  esac
done

[[ -n "$result_bundle" && -n "$expected_device" && -n "$required_tests_file" ]] || usage
[[ -d "$result_bundle" ]] || { echo "Missing result bundle: $result_bundle" >&2; exit 1; }
[[ -f "$required_tests_file" ]] || { echo "Missing required-test manifest: $required_tests_file" >&2; exit 1; }

expected_configurations='["Fixture Visual Tour","Smoke Local"]'
required_tests_json="$(jq -Rsc '
  split("\n")
  | map(gsub("^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$"; ""))
  | map(select(length > 0 and (startswith("#") | not)))
' "$required_tests_file")"
required_count="$(jq 'length' <<<"$required_tests_json")"
jq -e '
  length > 0
  and length == (unique | length)
  and all(.[]; test("^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*/test[A-Za-z0-9_]+$"))
' <<<"$required_tests_json" >/dev/null || {
  echo "Required-test manifest must contain unique Suite/testMethod identifiers without parentheses." >&2
  exit 1
}

if [[ -n "${HQ_XCRESULT_SUMMARY_JSON:-}" ]]; then
  summary="$HQ_XCRESULT_SUMMARY_JSON"
else
  summary="$(xcrun xcresulttool get test-results summary --path "$result_bundle" --compact)"
fi

jq -e \
  --arg expected_device "$expected_device" \
  --argjson expected_configurations "$expected_configurations" \
  --argjson required_count "$required_count" '
    .result == "Passed"
    and .failedTests == 0
    and .skippedTests == 0
    and .expectedFailures == 0
    and .totalTestCount == $required_count
    and .passedTests == $required_count
    and (.devicesAndConfigurations | length) == 2
    and all(
      .devicesAndConfigurations[];
      .device.deviceName == $expected_device
      and .device.modelName == $expected_device
      and .device.platform == "iOS Simulator"
      and (.device.deviceId | type == "string" and length > 0)
      and .failedTests == 0
      and .skippedTests == 0
      and .expectedFailures == 0
      and .passedTests == $required_count
    )
    and (
      [.devicesAndConfigurations[].testPlanConfiguration.configurationName] | unique | sort
    ) == $expected_configurations
    and ([.devicesAndConfigurations[].device.deviceId] | unique | length) == 1
  ' <<<"$summary" >/dev/null || {
  echo "xcresult summary is not an exact zero-skip, zero-failure $expected_device run in both required configurations." >&2
  exit 1
}

if [[ -n "${HQ_XCRESULT_TESTS_JSON:-}" ]]; then
  tests="$HQ_XCRESULT_TESTS_JSON"
else
  tests="$(xcrun xcresulttool get test-results tests --path "$result_bundle" --compact)"
fi

jq -e \
  --argjson required_tests "$required_tests_json" \
  --argjson expected_configurations "$expected_configurations" '
    [
      recurse(.children[]?)
      | select(.nodeType == "Test Case")
      | {
          identifier: (.nodeIdentifier | sub("\\(\\)$"; "")),
          result,
          configurations: [
            .children[]?
            | select(.nodeType == "Test Plan Configuration")
            | {name, result}
          ]
        }
    ] as $cases
    | ([$cases[].identifier] | sort) == ($required_tests | sort)
      and all(
        $cases[];
        .result == "Passed"
        and (.configurations | length) == 2
        and ([.configurations[].name] | unique | sort) == $expected_configurations
        and all(.configurations[]; .result == "Passed")
      )
  ' <<<"$tests" >/dev/null || {
  echo "xcresult test nodes do not exactly match the required IDs as passed in both configurations." >&2
  exit 1
}

result_udid="$(jq -r '[.devicesAndConfigurations[].device.deviceId] | unique | .[0]' <<<"$summary")"
if [[ -n "${HQ_SIMCTL_DEVICES_JSON:-}" ]]; then
  devices="$HQ_SIMCTL_DEVICES_JSON"
else
  devices="$(xcrun simctl list devices available --json)"
fi
jq -e \
  --arg expected_device "$expected_device" \
  --arg result_udid "$result_udid" '
    any(.devices[][]; .udid == $result_udid and .name == $expected_device and .isAvailable == true)
  ' <<<"$devices" >/dev/null || {
  echo "xcresult simulator is not the exact available device requested: $expected_device ($result_udid)" >&2
  exit 1
}

echo "Verified $required_count exact tests on $expected_device in both configurations with zero failures, skips, or expected failures."

+    static func parse(_ value: HQJSONValue?) -> HQRichMessageContent? {
+        guard case let .object(root)? = value else { return nil }
+        if let version = root["v"], !isVersionOne(version) { return nil }

+    private static func parseBlock(_ value: HQJSONValue) -> HQRichMessageBlock? {

+                guard !label.isEmpty || !value.isEmpty else { return nil }
+                return HQRichStatItem(
+                    label: label,
+                    value: value,
+                    delta: nonempty(safeText(item["delta"], maximum: maximumLabelLength)),
+                    trend: string(item["trend"]).flatMap(HQRichStatItem.Trend.init(rawValue:))
+                )
+            }
+            return items.isEmpty ? nil : .stat(items)
+        case "table":
+            let columns = array(object["columns"])
+                .prefix(maximumTableColumns)
+                .map { safeText($0, maximum: maximumLabelLength) }
+            let rawRows = Array(array(object["rows"]).prefix(maximumTableRows))
+            let rowWidth = rawRows.map { array($0).count }.max() ?? 0
+            let width = min(maximumTableColumns, max(columns.count, rowWidth))
+            guard width > 0 else { return nil }
+            let rows = rawRows.map { rawRow in
+                let cells = array(rawRow)
+                return (0..<width).map { index in
+                    safeText(index < cells.count ? cells[index] : nil, maximum: maximumCellLength)
+                }
+            }
+            let alignments = array(object["align"])
+                .prefix(width)
+                .map { HQRichBlockAlignment(rawValue: string($0) ?? "") ?? .left }
+            return .table(HQRichTable(
+                columns: columns,
+                rows: rows,
+                alignments: alignments,
+                caption: nonempty(safeText(object["caption"], maximum: maximumLabelLength))
+            ))
+        case "chart":
+            let series = array(object["series"])
+                .prefix(maximumChartSeries)

+                    )

+            guard !series.isEmpty else { return nil }
+            let kind: HQRichChart.Kind = string(object["chartType"]) == "bar" ? .bar : .line
+            return .chart(HQRichChart(
+                kind: kind,
+                series: series,
+                categories: array(object["categories"])
+                    .prefix(maximumChartPoints)
+                    .map { safeText($0, maximum: maximumLabelLength) },
+                caption: nonempty(safeText(object["caption"], maximum: maximumLabelLength))
+            ))
+        case "markdown":
+            let text = safeText(object["text"], maximum: maximumTextLength)
+            return text.isEmpty ? nil : .markdown(text)
+        case "badge":
+            let label = safeText(object["label"], maximum: maximumLabelLength)
+            guard !label.isEmpty else { return nil }
+            return .badge(label: label, tone: richTone(object["tone"]))
+        case "keyValue":
+            let items = array(object["items"])
+                .prefix(maximumKeyValueItems)
+                .compactMap { raw -> HQRichKeyValueItem? in
+                    guard case let .object(item) = raw else { return nil }
+                    let key = safeText(item["key"], maximum: maximumLabelLength)
+                    let value = safeText(item["value"], maximum: maximumCellLength)
+                    guard !key.isEmpty || !value.isEmpty else { return nil }
+                    return .init(key: key, value: value)
+                }
+            return items.isEmpty ? nil : .keyValue(items)
+        case "progress":
+            guard let value = finiteNumber(object["value"]) else { return nil }
+            let tone = object["tone"] == nil ? nil : richTone(object["tone"])
+            return .progress(HQRichProgress(
+                label: nonempty(safeText(object["label"], maximum: maximumLabelLength)),
+                value: min(100, max(0, value)),

+        case "callout":

+            guard !body.isEmpty else { return nil }

+            return .callout(HQRichCallout(

+                title: nonempty(safeText(object["title"], maximum: maximumLabelLength)),
+                body: body

+        default:
+            return nil
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static func array(_ value: HQJSONValue?) -> [HQJSONValue] {
+        guard case let .array(values)? = value else { return [] }

+    }
+
+    private static func string(_ value: HQJSONValue?) -> String? {

+        let raw: String

+                    || (14 ... 31).contains(code)

+            )

+        return String(sanitized.prefix(maximum)) + "…"
+    }

+    }

+    static let maximumHits = 8

+    static func normalize(
+        _ source: [HQMessageMentionCandidate]
+    ) -> [HQMessageMentionCandidate] {
+        var byUID: [String: HQMessageMentionCandidate] = [:]
+        for raw in source {
+            let uid = clean(raw.participantUID)
+            let name = clean(raw.displayName)
+            guard !uid.isEmpty, !name.isEmpty,
+                  raw.participantType == .human || raw.participantType == .agent
+            else { continue }
+            let candidate = HQMessageMentionCandidate(
+                participantUID: uid,
+                participantType: raw.participantType,
+                displayName: name,
+                email: nonempty(raw.email),
+                companyUID: nonempty(raw.companyUID),
+                companyName: nonempty(raw.companyName)
+            )
+            if let existing = byUID[uid] {
+                byUID[uid] = richer(existing, candidate)
+            } else {
+                byUID[uid] = candidate
+            }
+        }
+        let sorted = byUID.values.sorted { lhs, rhs in
+            let names = lhs.displayName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(rhs.displayName)
+            if names != .orderedSame { return names == .orderedAscending }
+            let emails = (lhs.email ?? "").localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(rhs.email ?? "")
+            if emails != .orderedSame { return emails == .orderedAscending }
+            return lhs.participantUID < rhs.participantUID
+        }
+        let nameCounts = Dictionary(grouping: sorted, by: { normalized($0.displayName) })
+            .mapValues(\.count)
+        return sorted.map { candidate in
+            guard nameCounts[normalized(candidate.displayName), default: 0] > 1 else {
+                return candidate
+            }
+            return HQMessageMentionCandidate(
+                participantUID: candidate.participantUID,
+                participantType: candidate.participantType,
+                displayName: candidate.displayName,
+                email: candidate.email,
+                companyUID: candidate.companyUID,
+                companyName: candidate.companyName,
+                disambiguator: candidate.companyName
+                    ?? candidate.email
+                    ?? candidate.companyUID.map(shortSuffix)
+                    ?? shortSuffix(candidate.participantUID)
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    static func activeQuery(in text: String) -> String? {
+        guard let at = text.lastIndex(of: "@") else { return nil }
+        if at != text.startIndex {
+            let previous = text.index(before: at)
+            guard text[previous].isWhitespace else { return nil }
+        }
+        let queryStart = text.index(after: at)
+        let query = text[queryStart...]
+        guard !query.contains(where: { $0.isWhitespace || $0 == "@" }) else { return nil }
+        return normalized(String(query))
+    }
+
+    static func filter(
+        _ candidates: [HQMessageMentionCandidate],
+        query: String,
+        excluding selectedIDs: Set<String>,
+        agentsOnly: Bool = false
+    ) -> [HQMessageMentionCandidate] {
+        let query = normalized(query)
+        return candidates.lazy.filter { candidate in
+            guard !selectedIDs.contains(candidate.participantUID),
+                  !agentsOnly || candidate.participantType == .agent
+            else { return false }
+            guard !query.isEmpty else { return true }
+            return normalized([
+                candidate.displayName,
+                candidate.email,
+                candidate.companyName,
+                candidate.disambiguator,
+            ].compactMap { $0 }.joined(separator: " ")).contains(query)
+        }.prefix(maximumHits).map { $0 }
+    }
+
+    static func applying(
+        _ candidate: HQMessageMentionCandidate,
+        to text: String
+    ) -> String {
+        guard activeQuery(in: text) != nil,
+              let at = text.lastIndex(of: "@")
+        else { return text }
+        return String(text[..<at]) + "@\(candidate.displayName) "
+    }
+
+    static func containsToken(for mention: HQMessagingMention, in text: String) -> Bool {
+        normalized(text).contains(normalized("@\(mention.displayName)"))
+    }
+
+    private static func richer(
+        _ first: HQMessageMentionCandidate,
+        _ second: HQMessageMentionCandidate
+    ) -> HQMessageMentionCandidate {
+        HQMessageMentionCandidate(
+            participantUID: first.participantUID,
+            participantType: first.participantType == .human ? .human : second.participantType,
+            displayName: first.displayName.count >= second.displayName.count ? first.displayName : second.displayName,
+            email: first.email ?? second.email,
+            companyUID: first.companyUID ?? second.companyUID,
+            companyName: first.companyName ?? second.companyName
+        )
+    }
+
+    private static func shortSuffix(_ value: String) -> String {
+        let clean = clean(value)
+            .replacingOccurrences(of: #"^(?:agt_|prs_|cmp_|co_|agent:)"#, with: "", options: [.regularExpression, .caseInsensitive])

+    }
+
+    private static func clean(_ value: String) -> String {
+        value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
+    }
+
+    private static func normalized(_ value: String) -> String {
+        clean(value).folding(
+            options: [.caseInsensitive, .diacriticInsensitive, .widthInsensitive],

+        )
+    }
